subject: Demo wrap: fit assessment, shortlist, and procurement path
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Ayla Stevens <ayla@streamlineai.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-16T21:02:00Z
Subject: Demo wrap: fit assessment, shortlist, and procurement path

Hi Ayla — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps while it's fresh: 

Summary of needs you called out:
- Near-real-time classification + short summarization in a customer-facing UI (p50 latency target ~200-300ms for 256-token responses)
- Strong factual consistency on invoices and policy language
- Multi-tenant setup with US data residency and SOC2 evidence for procurement
- POC target: ~1M tokens/mo expected during pilot, potential expansion to 10M/mo if POC successful

High-level fit and recommended shortlist (tradeoff quick view):
1) redwood-13b-v2-q4 — Best-quality/low hallucination profile. P50 latency (512 tokens) ~420ms on Dedicated; estimated cost ~ $0.85 per 1k tokens. Good for the classification + policy QA tasks.
2) mistral-8x-q4 — Strong quality/cost ratio. P50 latency ~480ms; cost ~ $0.45 per 1k tokens. Good for interactive user flows with throughput.
3) redwood-4b-q4 — Lightweight, very low cost (~$0.12 per 1k tokens), P50 ~230ms; acceptable for batch reranking and high-volume non-critical completions.

Notes on regressions/quality monitoring:
- We recommend shipping with the redwood-13b-v2-q4 baseline and a canary that routes 10% traffic to mistral-8x-q4 for performance comparison.
- We'll provide a prompt-set (attached) that mirrors your invoice/policy prompts so we can baseline hallucination and precision by label.
- Quality alerts we suggest: >3% drop in factual precision on the invoice prompt-set, or >10% increase in average hallucination tokens over baseline.

Attachments & links: benchmarks CSV with p50/p95 numbers (streamline_benchmarks_2027-05-16.csv), prompt sets (prompt_sets_streamline_v1.md), and a draft SOW (SOW_StreamlineAI_v1.docx). Full benchmark folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdEfG-streamline-benchmarks

Proposed next steps:
- You: confirm which dimension (cost vs latency vs precision) is an absolute priority for the POC by EOD Tuesday 5/18.
- Us: prepare a POC configuration and cost estimate (we can show hosted vs Dedicated numbers) and a 2-week eval plan with acceptance criteria.
- Procurement: if you want, we can loop in procurement contacts for a draft SOW/PO path — I can kick off a DocuSign link once you confirm scope.

Would you be available for a 30-min procurement & tech scoping call on 5/19 or 5/20? I can bring Lauren (policy/enterprise) and Dev (runtime/infra).

Thanks — Ben

-- 
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment stubs: streamline_benchmarks_2027-05-16.csv (CSV, 12KB), prompt_sets_streamline_v1.md (MD, 6KB), SOW_StreamlineAI_v1.docx (DOCX, 48KB)

From: Ayla Stevens <ayla@streamlineai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T23:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Demo wrap: fit assessment, shortlist, and procurement path

Thanks Ben — great demo and clear write-up. A few quick clarifications before we lock the POC scope: 

1) SLA / uptime: Our security team will need an option that supports a 99.9% SLA for the pilot — do you offer SLA-backed Dedicated or just hosted?
2) Data residency / keys: We must keep logs and keys in the US region; can you confirm the Private deployment option and KMS integration timelines?
3) Cost math: can you convert those per-1k-token estimates into an expected monthly bill for 1M and 10M token volumes (hosted vs dedicated)?
4) Acceptance criteria: for the invoice extraction prompt-set we want >95% label precision across our 10k test set. Can Redwood provide baseline precision numbers on a holdout run using the attached RFP examples?

Procurement note: we have a POC budget of $35k pre-approved for Q3. If the SOW and SLA look good we can move quickly. I've attached our internal RFP extract (streamline_rfp.pdf).

Yes, 5/19 11am PT works for a 30-min scoping call — please invite Lauren + Dev.

Best,
Ayla

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-17T16:12:00Z
Subject: Internal: StreamlineAI follow-up (priorities + POC config)

Folks — quick internal note after Ayla's reply. Key asks: SLA 99.9%, US residency/KMS, cost calc for 1M/10M tokens, and >95% precision on invoice prompt-set.

My recommended proposal for the POC (technical/commercial):
- Baseline model: redwood-13b-v2-q4 (route ~80% traffic) — best balance for factual tasks; we'll calculate expected cost using our Dedicated pricing table.
- Canary model: mistral-8x-q4 (route ~20% traffic) to validate throughput and unit cost on interactive flows.
- Fallback cheap path: redwood-4b-q4 for non-critical batch reranking and callbacks.
- Autoscaling: Dedicated pool with burst to Hosted (policy-defined) in case of load spikes; fallback path to hosted-inference with MTR scoring disabled for degraded latency but maintained availability.

Numbers to prepare for the call:
- Host vs Dedicated cost projections for 1M and 10M tokens (include initial warm KV cache assumptions).
- Baseline precision test: run the attached prompt set and the 10k invoice samples Ayla mentioned; capture label precision, hallucination rate, and latency distribution.
- SLA/Deployment: ops note on KMS integration timeline and SOC2 artifacts to share.

We should propose a 4-week POC: 1 week set-up & prompt tuning, 2 weeks active testing, 1 week acceptance & handoff. Given their $35k pre-approved, we should model a $28–34k POC price for Dedicated pilot (with contingency for heavy token usage).

I'll draft the SOW and the DocuSign link once we have the exact model targets and final token estimates.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Ayla Stevens <ayla@streamlineai.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-18T16:16:00Z
Subject: Follow-up: final shortlist + POC & procurement path (dates)

Hi Ayla — looping back with the concrete shortlist and the commercial path we discussed. I've answered your questions inline below and attached a compact cost table.

SLA / deployment
- We offer Dedicated with a 99.9% uptime SLA for production workloads. For the POC, Dedicated is available (standard 30-day onboarding). Private (VPC) + KMS integration is possible on the pilot but typically adds 1–2 weeks; we can do a scoped limited KMS integration during the POC and a full handoff for GA.

Cost math (hosted vs Dedicated) — rough estimates (exact in attached CSV):
- redwood-13b-v2-q4: 1M tokens ≈ $850; 10M tokens ≈ $8,500 (hosted list). Dedicated discounts typically reduce unit cost ~25% depending on commit.
- mistral-8x-q4: 1M tokens ≈ $450; 10M tokens ≈ $4,500.
- redwood-4b-q4: 1M tokens ≈ $120; 10M tokens ≈ $1,200.

Precision baseline / QA
- We've started a holdout run on 1k examples from your RFP; early signal for redwood-13b-v2-q4 is ~96% label precision (meeting your >95% bar) with the attached prompt-set. We'll deliver the full 10k holdout run before the call and include the detailed confusion matrix.

Proposed POC scope & timeline
- Duration: 4 weeks (1wk setup, 2wk test, 1wk acceptance).
- Models: primary redwood-13b-v2-q4 (80%), canary mistral-8x-q4 (20%), fallback redwood-4b-q4 for batch reranks.
- Acceptance: >95% label precision on invoice prompt-set and p50 latency <=450ms for 256-token responses.
- Cost: estimate $28k–$34k (Dedicated pilot, scoped to 1–2M tokens/month typical during active test).

Commercial path & next actions
1) Confirm priorities (cost vs latency vs precision) — Ayla to confirm by EOD 5/18.
2) If confirmed, I'll send an SOW via DocuSign (SOW_StreamlineAI_v1.docx) for signature and kick off procurement. DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/s#SOW-StreamlineAI
3) Schedule the scoping call: propose 2027-05-19 18:00Z (11am PT) — invite sent; Lauren will cover enterprise requirements and Dev will be on the technical deep dive.

Links & attachments included: benchmark CSV (streamline_benchmarks_2027-05-16.csv), prompt sets (prompt_sets_streamline_v1.md), draft SOW (SOW_StreamlineAI_v1.docx). HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4382

If that all looks good I’ll finalize the SOW and route to procurement.

Thanks again — excited to get this started.

Best,
Ben

-- 
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
